name: Sip Draw
description: Sip a mote of stray soul force from the air and add it to the user's own thin reserve.

name: Thin Tithe
description: Take a thin tithe from a faint soul probe before it lands and keep what it carried.

name: Pale Wick
description: Light a pale wick of soul force and read how much hostile force flows past it.

name: Gentle Drain
description: Draw soul force out of a target's weak push by small degrees until the push fades.

name: Small Cup
description: Fill a small cup of soul force from drawn force and drink it to steady a trembling soul.

name: Mote Siphon
description: Siphon the motes of soul force left in the air after a technique and add them to the user's reserve.

name: Hushed Pull
description: Pull at a target's gathering soul force so its technique starts weaker than it was meant to.

name: Soft Sponge
description: Let the soul soak the edge of a mental push like a sponge so little of it lands.

name: Siphon Tap
description: Tap the stored force and loose it in one short jolt at the soul of a target in reach.

name: Spent Dross
description: Throw the useless dross of a drawn technique back into a target's focus to scatter its thought.

name: Gleaning Reading
description: Glean the kind and weight of a hostile force from a single pass over it.

name: Calm Intake
description: Breathe in the soul force left by a spent technique and fold it into the user's reserve.

name: Slow Drawing
description: Draw soul force from a slow flow of hostile intent and store it a little at a time.

name: Muted Edge
description: Mute the edge of a soul jab by drawing its sharpest part into the user before it lands.

name: Draw Perceiving
description: Read the rate at which a hostile force can be drawn so the draw is never greedier than the soul can bear.

name: Dulling Pull
description: Pull at a target's soul steadily so its force flows thin and its technique comes out dull.

name: Settled Store
description: Settle drawn force into the soul's store so it does not leak back out.

name: Return Jolt
description: Send a small share of the drawn force straight back at the soul that sent it.

name: Slackened Stride
description: Step through the gap left where drawn force was lifted out of an attack.

name: Cistern Draw
description: Draw force from a hostile soul probe into a cistern of soul force held in the chest.

name: Deep Cistern
description: Keep a cistern of soul force open to take in the spill from nearby techniques and fill the reserve.

name: Lid Cover
description: Close a lid of soul force over the cistern so drawn force cannot be drawn back out by a foe.

name: Cistern Gauge
description: Gauge how full the cistern is and how much more it can take before it spills.

name: Spill Release
description: Let the spill from a full cistern fly out in a short burst at a nearby soul.

name: Pinch Valve
description: Pinch a valve of soul force on a target's gathering technique to starve it of force.

name: Brim Turning
description: Turn the soul aside on the cistern's rim so a strike meets only its edge.

name: Wick Reading
description: Hold a wick of soul force in a hostile flow and read how fast it burns.

name: Banked Mote
description: Bank a spark of drawn soul force low in the soul so it keeps and can be fanned later.

name: Fanned Coal
description: Fan a banked spark into a coal of soul force that lifts the strength of the next technique.

name: Snuffing Draw
description: Draw the flame from a target's gathered technique until it gutters out.

name: Cupped Flame
description: Cup a shade of soul force round the wick so a hostile gust draws nothing from it.

name: Ember Flick
description: Flick an ember of drawn soul force into the soul of a target within reach.

name: Levied Tithe
description: Levy a tithe of soul force from every hostile probe that touches the user.

name: Toll Reading
description: Read what toll a hostile force asks of the soul that draws it.

name: Tithe Guard
description: Take the tithe from a soul jab as it lands so the jab arrives half spent.

name: Exacting Pull
description: Pull the tithe from a target's soul each breath until its force runs low.

name: Counted Return
description: Return the counted tithe as one clean jolt against the soul that was taxed.

name: Tithe Step
description: Spend a tithe of drawn force to step lightly out of the way of a strike.
